title: OSCAR: Orthogonal Subspace Correction and Rectification of Biases in Word Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: Intrinsic evaluation using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT), a newly defined WEAT*, and the Embedding Coherence Test (ECT) to measure stereotypical associations (e.g., gender-occupation, work vs. home, and math vs. art). Extrinsic evaluation using Natural Language Inference (NLI) models as probes to measure neutrality and entailment when making counterfactual gender word substitutions in sentence pairs, introducing the Sentence Inference Retention Test (SIRT).
